rows.category_description: Supply of electricity
rows.comment: Reduced VAT rate on electricity.

rows.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
rows.comment: Reduced VAT rate on restaurant services (only non-alcoholic beverages). Alcoholic beverages in restaurants to be taxed at a standard rate of 23 %.

rows.category_description: Accommodation provided in hotels and similar establishments, including the provision of holiday accommodation and the letting of places on camping or caravan sites
rows.comment: The reduced VAT rate is applied for accommodation in the hotel sector or sectors with similar function, including renting of camping sites. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter m) of the Fiscal Code corroborated with point 37 para. (14) of the Methodological Norms.

codes.description: Room or unit accommodation services in youth hostels and holiday cabins

rows.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
rows.comment: The reduced VAT rate is applied for restaurant and catering services, excluding alcoholic beverages as well as non-alcoholic beverages, falling within CN codes 2202. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter n) of the Fiscal Code corroborated with point 37 para. (15) of the Methodological Norms.

codes.description: Meal serving services with full restaurant service

rows.category_description: Provision, construction, renovation and alteration of housing, as part of a social policy
rows.comment: The reduced VAT rate is applied for the supply of housing as part of social policy, including the land on which they are built (nursing homes and retirement homes, children's homes, and recovery and rehabilitation centers for minors with disabilities). For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter l) of the Fiscal Code corroborated with point 37 para. (16), (19) and (20) of the Methodological Norms.

codes.description: Non-residential buildings and associated land sales or purchases services

rows.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
rows.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Setting up and maintenance of genealogical registers of animal breeds; Determination of the genetic quality of animals. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and points 40, 41 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.

rows.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
rows.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Disinfection, plague and pest control in wineries and vegetable and fruit storage warehouses. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 30 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.

rows.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
rows.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Services to combat soil erosion such as Other landscape maintenance services (for the case of wind erosion). For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 42 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022, respectively in the Order no. 157/2011.

rows.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
rows.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Eggs packaging services, when packaging is the main activity, including sorting and marking, when these are related/auxiliary operations to packaging. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 32 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.

rows.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
rows.comment: The reduced VAT rate is applied for the services consisting in allowing access to castles, museums, memorial houses, historical monuments, architectural and archaeological monuments, zoological and botanical gardens. See art. 291 para. (2) letter h) of the Fiscal Code.

rows.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs

rows.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
rows.comment: The reduced rate is applied only if the supplier can prove that the goods, except foods with added sugar, whose total sugar content is at least 10g/100g product, are used as food for human or animal consumption. When those goods are imported from a third territory or a third country, the application of the reduced rate is conditioned by the submission of the Commitment Declaration regarding the destination of the goods. Point 37 para.(5)-(9) of Norms.
